## CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli / Node.js Remote Code Execution (Node2Shell)

### Summary

CVE-2026-111497 is a critical buffer overflow vulnerability affecting the Google Brotli decompression library, including its implementation within Node.js. The vulnerability originates from an out-of-bounds memory write in the Brotli decoder (`c/dec/decode.c`) when processing specially crafted compressed data. An unauthenticated remote attacker may exploit this vulnerability to corrupt application memory, disclose sensitive information, cause denial of service (DoS), or potentially achieve remote code execution (RCE). The vulnerability carries a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.2 (Critical) and affects applications that process attacker-controlled Brotli-compressed content. 

[image](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=https://www.tenable.com\&sz=32)

Tenable®

+1



Successful exploitation requires a vulnerable application to decompress malicious Brotli data, such as compressed HTTP requests or responses. Applications using Node.js, including Express-based web services, may be exposed when handling untrusted compressed input. Security researchers at Imperva have demonstrated successful remote code execution against vulnerable Node.js deployments, confirming the potential for application compromise. Public proof-of-concept code is available, although widespread exploitation in production environments has not been confirmed. Organizations should prioritize updating affected Node.js runtimes and Brotli libraries, particularly those supporting internet-facing applications. 

[image](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=https://www.imperva.com\&sz=32)

Imperva

+1



Affected Versions:

- Google Brotli: 1.0.3 through 1.2.0, excluding versions containing the applicable backported fix.
- Node.js: 22.x before 22.23.4, 24.x before 24.22.1, and 26.x before 26.12.1.
- End-of-life Node.js releases may also be affected and do not receive standard security updates.

Fixed Versions:

- Google Brotli: 1.0.10, 1.1.1, and 1.2.1, depending on the release branch.
- Node.js: 22.23.4, 24.22.1, and 26.12.1 or later.
